proposition: The top-level gate status fails exactly when configuration errors, blocking findings, or exception-policy blockers require failure.
non_claims: This claim does not establish that upstream findings, acknowledgements, or configuration errors are themselves classified correctly.
This claim does not establish availability or latency of the gate command.
This proof does not model String contents, heap allocation, vector destruction, or addresses; only warning/configuration-error slice emptiness is observed.
domain: Every GateMode constructor selected from the exhaustive, duplicate-checked GATE_MODES domain; all usize GateSummary counters and exception blockers; warning and configuration-error slices of zero or one empty String.
assumptions: The symbolic usize mode index is constrained below GATE_MODES.len(); the generated exhaustive match rejects omitted, duplicated, or newly added production constructors.
trust_dependencies: CBMC solver execution and result reporting
the pinned Rust verifier toolchain and target configuration
observable: The closed top-level status token and status_fails_gate decision.

bounds.warning_and_config_error_storage: immutable zero/one-entry slices over an empty String; production observes slice emptiness only

negative_controls: Mutation control: allow a blocking or configuration-error state to produce a non-failing status.
Compiler control: omit or duplicate a constructor, or add a production enum variant without extending the proof domain; the generated guard must reject compilation.
Guard-removal control: removing the exhaustive guard permits an omitted constructor while ordinary behavior tests remain green; those tests alone do not establish domain completeness.
result_satisfaction: One current verified row for the registered subject with every required constructor and status cover satisfied and no unreachable cover.
currentness_inputs: provider, solver and Rust toolchain identity
runner generation and effective verifier configuration
actual admitted merge-group and ordered member heads
transition_policy: base_and_head_remain_protected_until_an_explicit_generation-bumped replacement or recorded retirement is accepted
